title: Where the extra $100 for enterprise AI came from
subtitle: Incremental global enterprise AI deployment spending, 2026.
chart_title: Sources of spending and who received it

annotation.note: Other sources are the rounded remainder.

sources: [menlo] Menlo Ventures · November 2026 · global enterprise AI deployment
alt_text: For every additional $100 in enterprise AI deployment spending, $55 came from new budgets and about $23 from other sources. Existing software budgets supplied $22, of which $13 stayed with established vendors and $9 went to AI-native vendors.
